context: Evaluates correct implementation of the Sharpe ratio calculation as used in open-nof1.ai. The solution must fetch historical metrics from the Prisma database, extract totalCashValue time series, compute sequential returns, and calculate mean/std deviation to produce the Sharpe ratio, returning null for insufficient data.

checklist.name: Database query
checklist.description: The solution queries the Metrics table via Prisma for the Deepseek model record and extracts the metrics JSON array containing totalCashValue data points

checklist.name: Sequential returns computation
checklist.description: Returns are correctly computed as (value[i] - value[i-1]) / value[i-1] from the totalCashValue time series extracted from the metrics array

checklist.name: Mean and std deviation
checklist.description: Mean return and standard deviation of returns are correctly computed from the returns array

checklist.name: Sharpe ratio formula
checklist.description: Sharpe ratio is correctly returned as meanReturn / standardDeviation

checklist.name: Null handling
checklist.description: The function returns null when fewer than 2 data points exist in the metrics array, and handles zero standard deviation (division by zero) gracefully
